description: carnet-server: is it up, is it keeping up, who is connected, what it keeps, and what it said. Counts only; never what a note holds.

panels.title: Server
panels.description: Whether Prometheus could read the server's numbers on its last try. Down: the server is stopped, unreachable from Prometheus, or its hub stopped answering.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: The version the server says it is.

panels.title: Running for
panels.description: How long since the server last started.

panels.title: Failed writes
panels.description: Writes to the databases (or pictures to disk or the bucket) that failed in the time shown. Anything but 0 needs a look: a full disk, a broken file, a bucket out of reach.

panels.title: Hub lag
panels.description: How long the server's hub, which takes every device's messages in turn, kept the last reading waiting. Near 0 is normal; over a second it is falling behind.

panels.title: Online
panels.description: Devices logged in right now.

panels.title: Hub lag
panels.description: How long each reading waited for the hub. Yellow from a quarter second, red from a second: the alert fires after 5 minutes over a second.

panels.title: Time to handle each message
panels.description: How long the hub took over each message from a device: half of them took less than p50, all but 1 in 100 less than p99.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Connections open (any app, logged in or not) and, of them, devices logged in.

panels.title: Logged in, by protocol
panels.description: Devices logged in, by the sync protocol their app speaks: once nothing uses an old one, the server can drop it.

panels.title: Logged in, by app
panels.description: Devices logged in, by app and version, as each app says.

panels.title: Logins
panels.description: Logins let in and refused, per minute. Refused: a device the account doesn't know (taken out, or someone guessing).

panels.title: Opened and turned away
panels.description: Connections opened, those turned away for any reason, and of them those turned away for asking too much from one address (too many connections, or too many tries), per minute.

panels.title: Closed by the server
panels.description: Connections the server closed for its limits, per minute: one that wasn't reading what it was sent (budget), too long to sign in (login_timeout), nothing heard for 5 minutes (idle).

panels.title: Messages
panels.description: Messages from devices and to them, per second.

panels.title: Bytes
panels.description: Bytes of messages from devices and to them, per second. Pictures go by their own links and are not counted here.

panels.title: Logins by app (in the time shown)
panels.description: Logins let in during the time shown, by app and version.

panels.title: Accounts
panels.description: Accounts on this server.

panels.title: On disk
panels.description: What the server's databases take on disk (pictures in a bucket are not counted).

panels.title: Records kept
panels.description: Sealed changes to notes the server kept in the time shown.

panels.title: Pictures kept
panels.description: Pictures the server kept in the time shown.

panels.title: Not kept
panels.description: Batches of changes the server refused in the time shown: too big, an account over its limit, or something malformed. A few now and then are fine; many need a look.

panels.title: Pairings open
panels.description: Pairings waiting for a new device right now.

panels.title: On disk
panels.description: What the server's databases take on disk, over time.

panels.title: Kept
panels.description: Records (changes to notes) and pictures kept, per minute; notes compacted into one record.

panels.title: Bytes kept
panels.description: Bytes of records and of pictures kept, per second (sealed, as stored).

panels.title: Picture links and transfers
panels.description: Links given to put or fetch a picture, and pictures fetched (get) and put by them, per minute.

panels.title: Pictures let go
panels.description: Pictures no note shows any more, per minute: marked when a device says so, gone (deleted) 30 days later.

panels.title: New devices
panels.description: Invites redeemed (or refused), pairings opened, and devices let in by recovery words, per minute.

panels.title: Trouble
panels.description: The server's lines that speak of something going wrong (error, failed, denied, invalid, in use…). Empty is good.

panels.title: Server lines
panels.description: Everything the server's container printed, newest first. The server says little: when it starts, where it listens, when it stops, and what went wrong.

list.name: container
list.label: Container
list.description: The server's container name, as Alloy labels its lines (a regular expression).

title: Carnet server
